id.description: The unique ID of the Vega library item to create or update. A new ID must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores.

description.description: A short description of the Vega library item.

filters.description: Filters. Applied together with the dashboard filters to Elasticsearch and ES|QL data sources that use `%context%: true`, and to Elasticsearch data sources that use `%dashboard_context-*%` placeholders.

expression.description: A query expression in KQL or Lucene syntax.

language.description: Query language. Use `kql` for Kibana Query Language (KQL) or `lucene` for Lucene query syntax.

query.description: KQL or Lucene query. Applied together with the dashboard query to Elasticsearch and ES|QL data sources that use `%context%: true`, and to Elasticsearch data sources that use `%dashboard_context-*%` placeholders.

tags.description: Tag IDs associated with this library item.
